+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Give each new session a default name from its agent (D199 (b))
+---
+## Goal
+
+The Router owns the session facts (ROUTER-1), thus it owns the default name of a session (D199 (b), TestudoApp `features/decisions.md`, commit 740cd1a). Brief: `../.briefs/at-sessions/router-brief-at-sessions.md`, item 4.
+
+## Depends on
+
+FoundationModelsExtras: `SessionName.default(agentName:usedNames:)`. Do not start before it lands. Do not write a local copy of the rule.
+
+## Current behavior
+
+`complete(facts:with:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RouterSessionDirectory.swift:929`) sets `facts.title = facts.title ?? request.title`. A session with no title in the request has no title.
+
+## Change
+
+- When the directory registers a new session and the request has no title, set the title to `SessionName.default(agentName:usedNames:)`. `usedNames` are the titles of the sessions in the same folder that are not archived (live and recorded).
+- This applies to each start: `session/new` of a client, `start session` of the tool, and `startAgent` (`RouterSessionDirectory.swift:1365`).
+- A recorded session with no title (made before D199) gets the default name when the directory reads it.
+- Only a rename (`setTitle`, D197, D192 (c)) changes the name.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] A new session of the agent `claude-code` has the name `claude-code`.
+- [ ] A second one in the same folder has the name `claude-code-2`.
+- [ ] One in another folder has the name `claude-code`.
+- [ ] An archived session with the name does not block the name.
+- [ ] A request with a title keeps its title.
+- [ ] A rename replaces the default name, and the name stays after the next read.
+- [ ] A recorded session with no title reads with a default name.
+- [ ] `startAgent` gives the default name. #d199
\ No newline at end of file

-- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RouterSessionDirectory.swift:364` `completeness/public-output-contract` — In `giveDefaultTitle(to:)`, `try? Self.recordOwner(of: session)` discards the error and returns with no log. A root session that is not a `RoutedSessionActor` therefore registers with no default name, and no operator sees why. The sibling path in `recordedSummaries` logs its failure, so this site is inconsistent with the handling the change adds elsewhere. Replace `try?` with a `do`/`catch` that logs through `RouterTelemetry.makeLogger(.sessionDirectory)` with the session id, the same way `recordedSummaries` does, and then returns. The registration must still go on.
-- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RouterSessionDirectory.swift:382` `reuse/reuse` — recordedSummaries(besides:) rebuilds the usage-store recording-root list inline (`currentUsageStore()?.usages().values.compactMap(\.recordingRoot)`). That is the same gathering that allRecordingRoots() already does for the usage store. A second copy can drift from the first, for example if the root rule changes, and only one of the two copies gets fixed. Pull the usage-store root extraction out of allRecordingRoots() into a small non-async helper, for example `usageStoreRecordingRoots()`, and call it from both allRecordingRoots() and recordedSummaries(besides:). The sync and async paths then share one rule.
-- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Directory/RouterSessionDirectory.swift:1046` `completeness/invariant-propagation` — The title rule in `complete(facts:with:)` takes `request.title ?? facts.title`. An empty request title (`""`) is not `nil`, so it replaces the default name that `giveDefaultTitle(to:)` gave at registration. The live facts then hold an empty title. `SessionDefaultTitle.isMissing(in:)` treats an empty title as no title, so the empty-title rule is applied at that site but not at this one. A live session can end with an empty title, while a recorded read of the same session names it. Treat an empty request title as no title in `complete(facts:with:)`, for example `if let title = request.title, !title.isEmpty { facts.title = title }`. Add one test that starts a session with `title: ""` and asserts the live summary title is the default name `claude-code`.
